text:
mona: Heads up everyone  we crossed 500 million requests in 7 days at 20:12 PST. not even caffeine can explain this. :eyes:
sam: WHOA. moonpie truck at 10am tomorrow?
deploy-bot: Autoscale summary: handled peak traffic spike, 0 degraded instances. :white_check_mark:
kevin: huge shout to batch tuning and the new cache TTLs. saved a ton on burst slots. :raised_hands:
anya: tiny celebratory poll: moonpie truck (:one:) or karaoke night + neon stickers (:two:)? react :one: or :two:
pal: :two: but only if someone brings a kazoo.
orchid: remote people get a $20 snack stipend + digital neon sticker pack. good compromise?
ops-bot: Note: obs metric `sum(increase(requests_total[7d])) = 500012347` confirmed. nice margin. :bar_chart:
mona: tradition suggestion: person on-call at milestone gets to name the office plant. kevin you owe us a name.
kevin: naming rights accepted. will name plant "Throughput Tim".
sam: can we put a 30s clip of the monitoring dash in the next all-hands? short montage.
anya: yes, and call it "how we survived the moonpie storm".
orchid: i'll make a sleepy GIF thread to celebrate for remote folks. contributions welcome. :zzz:
mona: Logistics: moonpie truck at 10am in kitchen, karaoke at 6pm in lounge, neon stickers at reception. stipend for remote. bring your weird playlists. :party_popper:
deploy-bot: Badge awarded: "Half-Billion-Week" to team `runtime`. congrats! :tada:
